full_prompt_en: A loose animation character study shows a slim young man seated in a chair, his arms folded across his chest and his chin angled upward. He looks toward the upper left with a thoughtful, slightly skeptical expression. His hair sweeps away from the forehead in lively tufts, and an open-collared shirt creates broad triangular folds across his shoulders and chest. The pose is readable through a handful of strong structural lines: a tilted head, long neck, compact elbows, and diagonal chair back. Many lighter exploratory strokes remain visible around those final lines, tracing alternate placements for the shoulders, hands, and hair. The drawing is made on warm cream paper with layered blue pencil or colored graphite, touched by reddish-brown construction lines. Darker blue pressure accents the brow, nose, jaw, shirt folds, and overlapping arms, while the lower torso fades into quick loops and unfinished marks. Fine stray lines extend into the blank background, making the image feel like an active search for gesture rather than a polished final cel. Light is implied by the pale untouched paper, not by rendered shadows or painted color. The square page has ample open space around the figure, but the head and upper body hold a clear diagonal rhythm. Facial proportions are subtly stylized, emphasizing animation appeal and expressive silhouette while preserving believable anatomy. The result is warm, energetic, and intimate: a working drawing whose visible corrections and varied line weight reveal how the character takes shape.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅松动的动画人物习作中，瘦削的年轻男子坐在椅子上，双臂交叠于胸前，下巴微微上扬。他望向左上方，神情若有所思，又带一点怀疑。头发从额前活泼地向后梳起，敞开的衬衫领在肩胸间形成宽阔的三角褶线。少数有力的结构线就使姿态清楚：倾斜的头、修长的脖颈、收紧的手肘和斜向的椅背。围绕这些主线仍保留大量较浅的探索笔痕，试探肩膀、手和头发的其他位置。画面绘于暖奶油色纸上，以层叠蓝色铅笔或彩色石墨为主，加入少许红褐色结构线。较重的蓝色力度强调眉、鼻、下颌、衬衫褶皱和交叠的手臂；下半身则淡化为快速环线和未完成的笔痕。细小游离线伸入空白背景，让图像像是在主动寻找动态，而非打磨完成的动画赛璐珞。光感来自未着色的浅色纸面，而不是完整阴影或涂色。方形纸面在人物周围留下充足空间，但头和上半身构成清楚的斜向节奏。面部比例经过轻微程式化，强调动画人物的吸引力与表现性剪影，同时保留可信解剖。成品温暖、有活力且亲近；可见的修正与变化的线条力度揭示人物逐渐成形的过程。
style_prompt_en: An exploratory animation-pencil drawing style on warm cream paper. Layered blue lines and small reddish-brown construction marks search around the final pose, leaving corrections and loose arcs openly visible. Varied pressure moves from pale guides to dark accents at expressive focal points. Anatomy is believable but gently stylized, with clear gesture and appealing silhouettes taking priority over finished surface rendering. Large untouched paper areas serve as light and breathing space. Cropped or unfinished peripheral forms keep attention on concentrated facial and upper-body linework. The result is lively, intimate, and unmistakably handmade.
style_prompt_zh: 暖奶油色纸上的探索性动画铅笔画风。层叠蓝线与少量红褐色结构痕围绕最终姿态反复寻找，公开保留修正线与松动弧线。线条力度从浅淡辅助线变化到表情焦点处的深色强调。解剖可信又略经程式化，清楚动态与富有吸引力的剪影优先于完整表面渲染。大片未着墨纸面充当光和呼吸空间。外围形态可以局部裁切或保持未完成，使注意力集中于面部和上半身的线条。成品生动、亲近，带有鲜明手绘感。
theme_en: An animated character study of a thoughtful man seated with folded arms
theme_zh: 一幅动画人物习作：一名男子抱臂而坐、若有所思
name: Glen Keane
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
